Hi Sam —

Appreciate you taking time on the discovery call last week. We covered architecture fit and the main integration points, and Ben flagged a few model/latency constraints we want to demo in a short hands‑on session.

We had you down for a deeper demo yesterday but looks like things got pulled — no worries. To keep momentum I'd like to lock one 20‑minute window this week dedicated to:
- concise architecture recap (5m)
- live run of key inference path with your sample data (10m)
- next steps + integration owners & roll plan (5m)

Please pick one of the final windows below and reply with a firm "lock" — if we don't hear back by the end of the day we'll open the slots to other customers to preserve engineer availability.

Available (PST):
1) Wed Aug 18 — 09:30–09:50
2) Wed Aug 18 — 14:00–14:20
3) Thu Aug 19 — 11:00–11:20 (short notice)

Attachment: Redwood-MVP-demo-agenda.pdf (agenda + minimal runbook). Also attaching the Quantwise security questionnaire you sent; we'll have Marissa and our SOC contact at the ready if any items need a quick sync.

If none of these work, reply with two alternative 20m windows and we will try to accommodate, but we need a firm yes/no to preserve the engineering slot.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
